name: attio-common-errors
description: Diagnose Attio REST API failures from status, structured error fields, endpoint contract, and request context without exposing customer data. Use when an Attio request returns 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 429, or 5xx. Trigger with "Attio error", "Attio request failed", or "debug Attio API".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to locate the caller, response parser, retry policy, and logs. Use `WebFetch` only for current official Attio documentation. Use
